// A defineApi handler whose return value does not match the declared response schema.
import { defineApi } from "denext/server";
import { schema } from "./schema.ts";

interface Post {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  author: { name: string; email: string };
}

const draft = { id: 1, title: "Hello", author: { name: "Ada", email: 42 } };

export const GET = defineApi({
  response: schema<Post>(),
}, () => draft);
